[public_editorial_quality.report_analytical_depth_and_limitations] The planned themes are represented, and reuse across surfaces has distinct roles. However, several primary-analysis so-what lines restate findings without analytical implications. The India quick-commerce 25% share is also reported without clearly noting that the source does not specify its measurement method or further define the spending denominator. In addition, two advisory items include the 71% claim without that fact in their item-level evidence bindings. Dimensions: analytical_depth: Several primary-analysis so-what lines merely repeat the fact or its scope, without adding a defensible analytical implication.; limitations: The quick-commerce share is stated without noting that the source does not specify the measurement method or further define the spending denominator.
